item.title: Here and Now: Remembering the life and legacy of Rev. Jesse Jackson
item.description: Jesse Jackson was a major player on the world stage for over five decades. The Reverend died this past week at the age of 84, and tributes have been pouring in.

item.title: North Carolina man shot, killed by Secret Service and local deputy outside of Mar-a-Lago
item.description: The man was identified as 21-year-old Austin Tucker Martin from Moore County, North Carolina.

item.title: Mexican army kills leader of powerful Jalisco New Generation Cartel, 'El Mencho,' during operation
item.description: Videos show plumes of smoke over the city of Puerto Vallarta and travelers sprinting through the airport of the state's capital in panic.

item.title: DHS suspends Global Entry as partial government shutdown drags on; PreCheck still operational
item.description: DHS said Sunday that the Global Entry program would be shut down as long as the partial government shutdown continues. It comes after the department said it planned to shut down TSA PreCheck as well, but DHS later canceled the PreCheck closure.

item.title: AccuWeather Alert: Blizzard warning for NYC, Tri-State area
item.description: A rare Blizzard Warning is in effect for all 29 counties in our area through Monday evening, with heavy snow, powerful winds, and dangerous travel conditions already developing.

item.title: Fears of coastal flooding on Long Island amid powerful winter storm
item.description: Utility companies also have additional workers to help out in case of power outages.

item.title: Snowfall totals across New York City, Tri-State area from major winter storm
item.description: The Tri-State area is rapidly stacking up snow totals as a major winter storm pummels the region with snow and gusty winds.

item.title: How blizzard is impacting mass transit, including NYC subways, NJ Transit, LIRR
item.description: A major winter storm is impacting mass transit agencies and services across the Tri-State area, as most of the region braces for the potential of over a foot of snow.

item.title: New Jersey Gov. Mikie Sherrill urges people to stay home, warns of "most serious storm in 30 years"
item.description: New Jersey is under a travel ban Sunday night into Monday to keep residents off the roads as a major blizzard bears down on the state, the first blizzard warning to cover all 21 counties in three decades.

item.title: NYC getting slammed by snowstorm; Mamdani announces full snow day for public schools Monday
item.description: Conditions rapidly deteriorated in New York City Sunday night as a rare blizzard slams the Tri-State area with an intensity that will continue through Monday.
